composers_checked.note: Gap check against Apple Music and MusicBrainz (21 recorded chamber works): Op. 5 quartets (with No. 5b), the 1764 Sonate da camera and three trio sonatas are the recorded chamber works; 'Sinfonia a 4', flute concertos and 'orchestral trios' are orchestral. composers_checked.name: Scarlatti, Alessandro

composers_checked.name: Marini, Biagio
composers_checked.note: Pieces counted by IMSLP's contents lists (Op. 8 Nos. 14, 44, 45 match its own pages). composers_checked.name: Castello, Dario
composers_checked.note: Libro primo recorded complete by the AAM (2016); Libro secondo partly by Musica Fiorita (2012) and on MusicBrainz. 'Soprano' read as violin, as the census does; cornett parts of No. 17 put on the trumpet key. Libro secondo Nos. 15–16 count the bass viola as a cello part beside the organ.

composers_checked.name: Rossi, Salamone
composers_checked.note: Libro 4 sonatas Nos. 5–8 and 12 identified from recordings (IMSLP's Libro 4 page has no contents list); 'viole' of Libri 1–3 are viole da braccio (violins), not viols as the census read Libro 2. The dances of each book are one set entry each.

note: Census errors found: (1) Naudot's 6 Concertos Op. 17 were left out as 'unspecified instruments', but they are 'concertos en quatre parties' for a solo treble (musette, vielle, flutes, recorder or oboe), two violins and continuo, one to a part; Nos. 1, 2, 3, 5 added from that page (gap). (2) Barrière's Livre III is cello and continuo (duos) except No. 2, a trio; the census read the whole page as two cellos and continuo. (3) Zelenka ZWV 181: only No. 3 has a string part. (4) Rossi's 'viole' (Libri 1–2) are viole da braccio, entered as violins. Conventions to review: early-17th-century 'soprano' parts (Castello, Marini) entered as violins, as the census did; Castello's cornetts (Libro II No. 17) on the trumpet key and Graupner's chalumeau (GWV 210) on the clarinet key, named in notes. Bass parts beside the continuo counted as parts for Williams (violone part, as Purcell in c03), Graupner GWV 211 and Castello Libro II Nos. 15–16; folded into the continuo for Richter Op. 3/4 and Franceschini Op. 1 (unverified). Rossi's dance books are one set entry each; Marini's recorded dances and sinfonie are single entries. Not checked or weak: Scarlatti's Naples recorder concertos matched to Sardelli's numbering by key (A major, C major, G minor medium); Franceschini's recording credits only 'Franceschini' (keys match Gaetano's Op. 1); Marini Sonata terza Op. 8 No. 3 and Capriccio Op. 8 No. 14 rest on one anthology track each; Graupner trios GWV 712–723 not looked up individually; Zelenka, Erlebach and Scarlatti orchestral works left out as orchestral, consistent with c07/c09.
